title: Bug Report
body:
**Bug Description**


> when I make a new text box, and I click the backgorund to deselect, the Aa text box stays 
selected in the layers panel.  then when I select the Arrow selectiont tool, it selects the text 
box, but there ar no TextBox Selected. this is miss leading. the user have to click the text box to
 active it..  The fix is if the user clicks away fro mthe text box at any time (Aa or Arrow tool) 
it deselcts the text box.. (shouild be in .gray mode) and .gray mode should never show aselection 
or be selected in the layers panel. Also be sure we are using the .text type.
